newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woolworths says profit rise unlikely.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woolworths says profit rise unlikely.

text.p: Major food and grocery retailer Woolworths Ltd said on Thursday that it would be unwise to expect an improvement in profitability in the current 1996/97 financial year.
The company told shareholders at the annual meeting that trading in the month of October had shown some better signs.
"It would be unwise to expect an improvement in profitability from an improvement in operating margins this financial year," chairman John Iliffe said.
"Trading in October has shown better signs but it is too early to predict a pickup in sales," Iliffe said.
The company had a steady net profit in 1995/96 (July-June) of A$233.6 million compared with A$233.5 million a year earlier. Operating profit rose 5.56 percent to A$360.6 million.
The company, which competes in the national market with Coles Myer Ltd, said last month that first quarter sales had risen by 8.24 percent to A$3.85 billion.
